message: 一仕事
My power punched straight through Bylous's slightly lowered guard!

name: Bylous
message: 「Guhah!」
All movement stopped.
In a scene where time seemed stretched out, Bylous staggered and collapsed straight backward.

name: Synn
message: 「Haa, haa, haa...」
Lying sprawled with his arms spread out like a cross, Bylous looked up at the sky.
Countless shooting stars filled the dark sky, as if grains of diamonds had been scattered across it.
That sky, brimming with omens of ruin, was more magnificent than any night sky I had ever seen.

name: Bylous
message: 「Is this the end...」

name: Melphas
message: 「Is it over?」

name: Paqy
message: 「That settles it.」

name: Bylous
message: 「A battle against the legendary Demon Lord. I had hoped to enjoy it a little longer.」
Giving a small nod, Bylous looked up at me from where he lay and smiled.

name: Bylous
message: 「O Demon Lord. No, Synn Sakura. Victory is yours.」

name: Synn
message: 「Haa, haa... A-Are you satisfied now?」

name: Bylous
message: 「Yes. It was an intense, blissful, and wonderful moment.」
Perhaps because he had fulfilled his long-cherished wish, Bylous looked deeply satisfied.

name: Bylous
message: 「I do hope you will let me savor a time like this again someday.」

name: Synn
message: 「Haa, haa... N-No thanks.」
I undid my transformation.

name: Melphas
message: 「Now then, it appears the time for violence has come to an end. Shall we move on to a delightful time for dancing next?」
I checked my watch. Twenty minutes left.
